tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Grant that we lie down in peace

tei:respStmt.tei:resp: Read from the 1949 scan and encoded by
tei:respStmt.tei:name: Efraim Feinstein

tei:editionStmt.tei:edition: Read directly from the scanned 1949 printing, page by page

tei:div.tei:p:
Grant, Lord our God, that we lie down in peace, and that we rise again, O our King, to life. Spread over us thy shelter of peace, and direct us with good counsel of thy own. Save us for thy name’s sake; shield us, and remove from us every enemy and pestilence, sword and famine and grief; remove the adversary from before us and from behind us; shelter us in the shadow of thy wings;
for thou art our protecting and saving God; thou art indeed a gracious and merciful God and King. Guard thou our going out and our coming in, for life and peace, henceforth and forever. Blessed art thou, O Lord, who guardest thy people Israel forever.
